final: SELECT g.ArtistId, g.c, CAST(g.c AS REAL) / s.total AS ratio FROM (SELECT ArtistId, COUNT(*) AS c FROM Album GROUP BY ArtistId) g JOIN (SELECT SUM(c) AS total FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM Album GROUP BY ArtistId) WHERE c IS NOT NULL) s ON s.total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10
